cards.t: Cysic Bridge Suspended After Unauthorized Token Mint
cards.b: Cysic halted its crypto bridge after an attacker made an unauthorized mint of 10 million CYS tokens, moving about $727,000 in proceeds to Ethereum.

per.CYS: Bridge halted and tokens minted without authorization, causing potential security concerns.

cards.label: NEGATIVE CATALYST
cards.missing: Total financial loss outside of the bridged amount and exact recovery status.

cards.t: Grayscale Files With SEC for First US Bittensor ETP Listing
cards.b: Grayscale has filed with the SEC to launch the first US Bittensor ETP listing.

per.TAO: Filing could bring institutional ETP access to the asset.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Approval timeline and exchange venue details.
